For a Southern Hemisphere location, the minimum noon solar altitude corresponds to the June solstice/winter solstice period, so stage III is just after that, still in Southern Hemisphere winter. Since Sydney is in the Southern Hemisphere and in this period it is still before the equinox, conclude that in stage III Sydney has short days and long nights: 昼短夜长.
